title: Triangulated closure of the rational evaluation class
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and a scheme $X$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$ be the completed coefficient sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and let $(\mathcal S,\mathcal R)$ be either $(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X})$ or the slice $(X_{\mathrm{proet}}/U,\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}|_U)$ over an object $U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Let $\mathcal T$ be the derived category of sheaves of $\mathcal R$-modules on $\mathcal S$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], an $\mathcal O_E$-linear triangulated category, with derived internal Hom $R\mathcal Hom$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and the completed tensor product $\widehat\otimes^L$ of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], formed on $\mathcal S$ with the restricted coefficient sheaves. Let $Q:\mathcal T\to\mathcal T[1/\varpi_E]$ be the scalar localization [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization] with its triangulated structure [lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-triangulated]. Fix $M\in\mathcal T$ derived complete in the sense of [def-weil-derived-complete] (formed on $\mathcal S$). Then the contravariant functors $\Phi(L)=R\mathcal Hom(L,\mathcal R)\widehat\otimes^L M$ and $\Psi(L)=R\mathcal Hom(L,M)$ on $\mathcal T$ are exact and $\mathcal O_E$-linear, and the canonical evaluation comparison $\theta_{L,M}:\Phi(L)\to\Psi(L)$ (the adjunct of evaluation; $\Psi(L)$ is derived complete) is natural in $L$ and compatible with the shift isomorphisms. Hence $\Phi,\Psi$ induce exact functors on $\mathcal T[1/\varpi_E]$ and $Q(\theta_{-,M})$ is a natural transformation between them compatible with shifts. The class $\mathcal S_M$ of objects $L$ for which $Q(\theta_{L,M})$ is an isomorphism in $\mathcal T[1/\varpi_E]$ contains $\mathcal R[0]$ and $0$, and is closed under isomorphisms in $\mathcal T[1/\varpi_E]$, finite direct sums, retracts in $\mathcal T[1/\varpi_E]$, shifts, and extensions: if $L_1\to L_2\to L_3\to L_1[1]$ is a distinguished triangle of $\mathcal T[1/\varpi_E]$ and two of the $L_i$ lie in $\mathcal S_M$, so does the third.

proof.text: Apply lem-sf-integral-completed-evaluation to obtain the integral linear exact functors, completeness, uniquely normalized evaluation and its invertible coefficient component. Install the supplied shifts.
Apply lem-sf-completed-evaluation-rational-descent to obtain rational exact functors, their shifts and a shift-compatible rational transformation satisfying the intertwining equation.

Evaluate the intertwining equation on each unchanged rational object. The comparison isomorphisms identify evaluationLocus with the opposite of the descended transformation’s isomorphism locus. The proved source-library NatTrans.isoLocus instances make this triangulated and stable under retracts; op reverses the retract. This is the triangle-morphism argument of lem-sf-triangle-morphism-iso assembled in the source library. Retract stability implies closure under isomorphisms.

The coefficient component remains invertible under q. For a finite diagram the triangulated isomorphism locus contains its product. Transport this membership through the canonical biproduct colimit-to-limit isomorphism and the given colimit presentation. This includes the empty diagram and zero. Assemble all conjuncts with exactly the supplied shifts.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q87-44cb5048d (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, the new node, every cited node, the unit, the parent and the cited Stacks places in full. New node lem-sf-ringed-rhom-derived-complete matches Stacks 099A (algebraization.tex) exactly, with local completeness as in Definition 0999, where T(K,f) is R Hom(O_f,K). It adds and drops no hypothesis, and K=0, N=0, I=0, I=O and the Z_p examples Q_p and a free sum are consistent. It is not a duplicate: lem-coef-integral-hom-reduction gives the same conclusion only on the global X_proet, while the item needs arbitrary slices; the reflector, Cech, restriction and flat-equivalence nodes do not state Hom preservation. The node has only a statement and the B fields are correct. Item steps: (1) O_E is a Noetherian DVR, so the constant-completion lemma, whose last paragraph covers Koszul and quotient completion for the completed sheaf, together with the reflector applies on slices. I checked that the Roos-triangle definition of completeness agrees with the local condition, through TR3 and invariance under isomorphism. (2) The balanced tensor identification gives completed tensor = C(ordinary tensor). (3) K-flat cones, the tensor cone identification and the exact strict-tower R lim (no product exactness needed) make C exact. (4) Internal Hom is exact with signed shifts, O_E-linearity holds componentwise, and the new node plus step 1 make Psi(L) complete. (5) theta is the unique map with theta eta = e, natural by the reflector bijection. (6) I re-derived the shift sign (-1)^(a+b); the evaluation model is internal composition, as in lem-sfb-ringed-site-duality-maps. (7) The completed shift square holds because complete shifts are complete. (8) Fractions descend because the functors are O_E-linear, and exactness descends because every localised triangle is isomorphic to the image of an integral one. (9) For the unit, theta = e eta^-1, which uses completeness of M; with M=E on a point the map fails, so the hypothesis is needed. (10)-(11) Isomorphism, sum, shift and retract closure hold; I multiplied out the retract inverse. (12) Extension closure follows from 014A in T[1/t]. The statement is unchanged and serves the parent's steps 9-10 on slices. There is no cycle (766 nodes followed), no missing or merged citation, no SGA source, and proof_deps equals the union of uses. I accept all 10 off-route tool_uses as generic ringed-site tools; the unit's sentence on exact functors and direct summands is carried by steps 3-4 and 8-12. Minor: the step-8 source 05R6 and the step-3 source 07A3 are loosely placed but not wrong. I made no fixes.
